run_grpo_vlm_training: run GRPO training for a vision language model using CARLA driving environment with multimodal tool responses
configure_lora_training: configure LoRA fine-tuning with custom rank, alpha, and target modules for memory-efficient VLM training
compute_episode_rewards: compute rewards for GRPO completions by advancing CARLA simulation to episode end and extracting rubric reward

create_multimodal_observation: create multimodal observation content blocks combining camera images and text scene descriptions from CARLA environment
